policy: US-009 AC1 dependency-unsafe inventory. The rust/ workspace is dependency-free by design (std only; see docs/rust-workspace.md): cargo metadata must report zero non-path dependencies, and the dependency-inventory gate (cmd/rustgatectl) verifies that mechanically on every run. The empty list below is the stated inventory of dependency unsafe: zero external crates, zero dependency unsafe. If a non-path dependency ever enters the workspace, the gate FAILS until a reviewed entry lands here with the shape {"name", "version", "source", "unsafe_usage"}, where unsafe_usage is a non-blank statement of the crate's unsafe surface and its review outcome. Entries with no matching dependency are stale and also fail the gate.
